main:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, 
      username TEXT UNIQUE, 
      password TEXT,
      role TEXT DEFAULT 'admin',
      avatar TEXT,
      twofa_secret TEXT,
      twofa_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS activities (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, 
      title TEXT, 
      tag TEXT,
      date TEXT, 
      description TEXT, 
      content TEXT, 
      cover_image TEXT, 
      images TEXT, 
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      created_by INTEGER,
      updated_by INTEGER,
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'published',
      deleted_at DATETIME,
      deleted_by INTEGER
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS members (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, role TEXT, avatar TEXT, school TEXT, tags TEXT, sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0, deleted_at DATETIME, deleted_by INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, date TEXT, title TEXT, description TEXT, image TEXT, sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0, deleted_at DATETIME, deleted_by INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS login_attempts (
      ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      lock_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS banned_ips (
      ip TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      reason TEXT,
      created_at INTEGER,
      expires_at INTEGER,
      created_by TEXT
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
    title TEXT,
    content TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'draft',
    created_by INTEGER,
    visitor_ip TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_participants (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    user_id INTEGER,
    visitor_ip TEXT,
    common_id TEXT,
    machine_sign TEXT,
    pilot_source TEXT,
    qq TEXT,
    avatar TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(event_id, user_id),
    UNIQUE(event_id, visitor_ip),
    FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_history_deleted_at ON history(deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_members_name ON members(name)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_members_deleted_at ON members(deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_participants_event ON event_participants(event_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_participants_user ON event_participants(user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_participants_ip ON event_participants(visitor_ip)
